items.label: MA-AG civil: RBS Financial Products Inc.
items.detail: Assurance of discontinuance over securitizing presumptively unfair subprime loans; date is the announcement date. Release states $52 million: more than $40.2 million borrower relief, more than $8.9 million to the Commonwealth, more than $2.6 million to municipalities. Cash-only rule applied 2026-10-11: amount changed from 52,000,000 to 11,500,000; the part not counted is listed in data/manual/excluded-amounts.csv as xa-004.

excluded_amounts.reason: Release: "More than $40.2 Million to be used for principal reduction and related relief" for borrowers, "More than $8.9 Million payment to the Commonwealth" and "More than $2.6 Million" to municipalities. Counted: the two cash payments ($11.5 million). Not counted: the principal reduction (headline less counted).
excluded_amounts.category_label: Debt relief, loan modification or account credits
